_meta.source: Per-country food-security news and bulletin sources, researched and URL-verified 2026-08-31
_meta.notes: One or more reporting sources per country: national statistics offices, agriculture ministries, early-warning units and credible national media, preferring machine-readable feeds. 59 of 214 scored countries covered so far; 55 have at least one RSS/API feed; 204 sources total. Every URL was fetched — http_status and latest_item_seen are OBSERVED values, not inferred. PARTIAL: this sweep covered Africa (east/south), Central America, the Caribbean, the Andes and the major Latin American producers. Africa (west/central), MENA, Asia, Europe and Oceania are NOT yet covered — those research runs were cut off by a rate limit and must be completed before this file is presented as global. Absence of a country here means it has not been researched, NOT that it has no source.

Directly relevant recurring series: 'Selected Food Prices <Month>' and 'Cost of Healthy Diet Report <Month>', both monthly. Observed: 'Selected Food Price July 2026' dated 2026-08-29 and 'Cost of Healthy Diet Report July 2026' dated 2026-08-31. CRITICAL GOTCHA: the array is a release CALENDAR and contains FUTURE scheduled entries (records dated through 2026-12-31 were present on 2026-08-31) - you MUST filter `start <= today` or you will publish unreleased items as news. No RSS exists (/feed and /rss are 404).
